tutorial.heading: How this works
tutorial.step1: Open the order and look at each photograph.
tutorial.step2: Tell us the date you can have the pieces ready, then press accept.
tutorial.step3: Weave the sarees. Write the code shown under each photograph on the piece.
tutorial.step4: New design cards have no code. Leave those pieces unlabelled.
tutorial.step5: When you send them, enter the date sent and the transport docket number.
